related_issues.reason: Discusses --active flag behaviour for uv add/sync; context for how --active works
uv sync --active interacting with the active/project venv; related --active behaviour

rationale: Reporter asks for a new --active flag on uv lock as a temporary workaround for the underlying problem in #19832 (uv lock failing on an invalid .venv). The underlying failure is the actual bug and is tracked there; this request is for new behaviour, so enhancement. Searches did not surface #19832 itself, so it is not listed as a duplicate; maintainers likely close in favour of fixing #19832 since lock should not need the project venv. No reproduction needed: the layout of .venv is described.
